# Over7Under

> Over7Under is a free, casual 3D browser dice prediction game. Players guess whether two rolled dice will total higher than 7, lower than 7, or exactly 7, using virtual play credits with no real-money risk.

## Pages

- [Home / Game](https://over7under.sohangrg.me/): The main single-page application containing the interactive 3D WebGL dice game, game rules, how-to-play guide, probability odds table, tips, and an FAQ section.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://over7under.sohangrg.me/overview.md): Detailed overview of the game, its mechanics, payout rules, and probability breakdown.
